title: The vinyl record revival: records outselling CDs in the US and why buyers choose vinyl

sources.title: Vinyl records outsell CDs for the first time since 1987
Gen Z’s search for decorative collectibles is fueling vinyl sales
Appetite for 'authentic sound' pumps up demand for vinyl records, Winnipeg shop owners say

facts.text: In the United States, vinyl albums outsold CDs in 2022 for the first time since 1987.
Vinyl sales have grown for many years even though streaming remains the main way people listen to music.
Many young buyers say they like vinyl for its look and use records or covers as home decoration.
A large share of record buyers in the US do not own a turntable.
Buyers often mention a warmer sound, the physical experience of owning music, and nostalgia; whether vinyl sounds better is debated.

notes: 混合題 mixed-advanced-03 第 2 組用（2026-10-09 線上查證）。選文只用「在美國，黑膠唱片現在賣得比 CD 多」這一個事實（不寫數字）；8 則留言都是虛構讀者的個人看法（音色、封面、回憶、儀式感、支持樂團、收藏），不是事實陳述。
